summary: Private complaint seeking prosecution for cheating and criminal breach of trust; goods supplied on change of billing entity; payment diversion to Delhi Horse Trainers Association; demand threats and scuffle; magisterial inquiry under CrPC s.202; process issued under IPC s.406; HC upheld summoning order; SC examines whether complaint discloses cognizable offence; standard for summoning order vs full trial; no pre-trial evaluation of defence; process not quashed; allegations prima facie maintainable.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court decision upheld; summoning order maintained; trial to proceed.
